Excited to announce that @JSeyff and I have a new book coming out this fall called "Both Sides of the Coin" which is available for pre-order now. We thought it was time for a fresh look at bitcoin/crypto post-ETF and sought to write a fair and balanced book for everyday TradFi investors as well as crypto natives that tracks the risks, rewards, evolution and financialization of the asset class as well as the growing debasement/debt problem. We took great pains to cover as much as ground as poss in this 370-page book, no stone was left unturned. Here's a look at the chapters:
1. Bitcoin in a Nutshell (much more of an engineering feat than most ppl think)
2. The Currency Debasement Problem (inflation, debt etc is crucial for anyone hoping to understand the ‘purpose’ of btc as well as the rise of socialist politicians)
3. Store of Value Smackdown (btc vs gold)
4. Bitcoin in a Portfolio (hot sauce, for now)
5. The Filing Heard 'Round the World (the untold inside story of how Blk/Larry Fink evolved enough to file for ETF)
6. The ETF Solution (ETFs have solved for good bitcoin’s ‘intermediary problem’ eg FTX, Coldcard etc)
7. Suitcoiners (wall street/govt adoption, which OGs should embrace not dump on)
8. Alt Coins (top 12-ish cryptos explained in detail as well as how to evaluate them)
9. A Tokenized Future (the blockchain-ization of wall st and beyond)

这话真的很有道理，在 60,000 美元附近震荡的时候，我几乎天天能看到很多老师在宣传“下周一定破 55,000 美元”，“月底一定破 50,000 美元”这种话，其中不乏一些非常有名的老师，所以给很多小伙伴一种错觉，就是 bitcoin:native 一定会跌下来。

I don’t agree with Cheds on a lot of things but this type of attitude needs to get lost from this space. Regardless of what he shares, right or wrong, it’s on YOU and you ONLY to make a decision based on whether you agree with him or not. If you DO agree with what he’s saying, and act based on it, then if things don’t pan out why is that somehow on him and not on you? He didn’t force you to pull the trigger on anything, he shared his honest thoughts, you clearly came to the same conclusion, acted on it, and now must accept the results. And if you DONT agree with him in the first place then why would you take actions based on what he says to begin with? Bottom line- if you agree with what he says and act on it- the results are on you. If you don’t agree with his analysis then don’t act on it and find someone else whose views make more sense to you. Don’t come at him because you’re upset with your own decisions based on an outcome that no one ever knows 100%.
